page.layout: One page of text, all lines centred. Title block from top to bottom, then a small ornament (not text), then the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: Ecclesiæ Dei, cùm priscis, tum recentibus:
Cur nempe illæ & à Deo infligantur, & ab homine Christiano æquo animo ferri debeant: ubi & de Persequutorum nonnullorum horrendis pœnis:
Professore S. Literarum in Schola Tig.
Subiecta disquisitioni publicæ, die Synodum Maii proxime insequente.

page.notes: The handwritten "16." in the upper right corner is a manuscript pagination mark, not printed, so it is left out. The small fleuron ornament above the imprint is not text and is left out. The line "Maii proxime insequente." is partly worn at its left end; the words are read from the context and the visible letters, but "Maii" and "insequente" are slightly unclear in the scan and are not marked, as they are legible enough.
